mission: Used Mazda 6 2.5L Skyactiv-G, GCC, 2015–2020 for Atir. Daily Dubailand→Meydan (~35 km/day, Al Ain Rd) + road trips to Oman, Saudi, Al Ain with passengers. Realistic 19–20K km/yr. Horizon: flexible 1–4 years, governed by the repair caps below. Charger/Mustang deferred to year three.
hardRules: GCC spec only — VIN prefix JM6/JM7 proceed, JM1 (US) reject. Check VIN before anything else.
2.5L Skyactiv-G engine only. Never infer from listing filters (1500–1999cc bracket hides 1.6L/2.0L). Confirm via VIN or mulkiya.
No Sharjah registration — hard geographic exclusion.
AutoTrust chassis check (800 2978) mandatory on any serious candidate.
Independent ~AED 300 garage inspection (buyer's choice of garage) before any payment. Never Dubizzle Book Inspection (2.6 Trustpilot, conflict of interest).
REPAIR CAPS: expected repairs must fit ≤ AED 5,000 in year 1 AND ≤ AED 5,000 total across years 2–4. Cars unlikely to fit both caps fail, regardless of price.
2018–19 cars: verify rocker-arm campaign + Denso fuel pump recall via VIN at Galadari before considering.

budget.strategy: Flexible horizon (1–4 yrs) with hard repair caps
budget.note: The caps replace the old one-year-bridge framing. Consequence: documented service history and lower mileage now outweigh a cheaper sticker — a 200K-km car with unknown history rarely fits ≤5K/yr1 + ≤5K/3yrs. Sub-25K listings still reliably fail at least one hard rule.

general.a:
**Image classified: WhatsApp chat screenshot — Greeshma's 2016 Mazda 6 (c2)**

---

**Engine bay verdict: ACCEPTABLE — but not clean**

What I can see:
- ✅ Mazda Skyactiv badge confirmed — right engine
- ✅ No obvious oil seepage on visible surfaces
- ✅ No corroded terminals or mismatched components visible
- ⚠️ **Very dusty/grimy** — she acknowledged it herself ("must get the car washed")
- ⚠️ Grime buildup makes it harder to spot slow seeps or hairline cracks — this is exactly why a mobile PPI inspector matters; they'll degrease and look properly
- ✅ No missing covers, no aftermarket nonsense visible

**The dust is cosmetic, not a red flag on its own.** But it's a reason to not skip the independent inspection.

---

**Key update: visit is now on the table**

She's invited you to come see it. Engine bay photo obligation — which was your blocker — is now **partially fulfilled** (enough to proceed to visit, not enough to skip PPI).

**Next move:**
Reply to confirm a visit time. Suggested message:

> *"Thanks for sending! Looks good. I'm free Tuesday or Wednesday evening — what works for you? I'll plan to bring an inspector along if that's okay, just my usual process for any car I'm serious about."*

Booking a mobile inspector (Inspect Motors or Checkmycar) to meet you there is the right call — saves a second trip.

---

**Repair-cap reminder going into the visit:**
No service records = the unknown that blows the cap. Push hard on paperwork when you're there. Even partial Galadari dealer stamps help.
